name: com.pixygon.avatar
description: The humanoid body for an Actor — a Mii-like, ID-based, customizable avatar. Engine-portable core (AvatarSlot + AvatarSpec) + a Unity adapter (AvatarPart catalog, AvatarBuilder, renderer seam, race body-modes). Reads the shared AvatarData from com.pixygon.saving; implements IBody from com.pixygon.actors.
